covered.hi: Aaj dekha ki barabar tukdon ko hi gin kar naam dete hain, aur neeche wala number saare tukde ginta hai.
covered.en: Today we saw that only equal pieces are named by counting, and the bottom number counts all the pieces.

hook.convey: one whole (a roti, a drawn circle) cut and shared → fair only if the pieces are the same size; equal pieces of one whole get the names half, third, quarter; the number of pieces alone does not decide the name

use.hi: Kitchen mein Maa ne garam roti banayi, aur tum do bhai-behen ho: dono ke tukde barabar hone chahiye.
use.en: Mum made a hot roti in the kitchen, and there are two of you: both pieces should be equal.

use.hi: Drawing book mein ek gol roti banao; use barabar tukdon mein baant kar ek tukde mein rang bharenge.
use.en: Draw a round roti in your drawing book; we'll split it into equal pieces and colour one piece.

explain.convey: roti cut into 2 same-size pieces → each piece = half = 1/2; bottom 2 = equal pieces in the whole, top 1 = pieces taken

viewCaption.hi: Wahi roti ab ek patti ban gayi hai: do barabar tukde, ek mein rang, ek bina rang ka. Dono tukde ek jitne lambe hain.
viewCaption.en: The same roti is now a strip: two equal pieces, one coloured, one uncoloured. Both pieces are the same length.

point.hi: Yeh roti 2 barabar tukdon mein kati hai, aur ek tukde mein rang hai. Fraction mein neeche wala number roti ke kul barabar tukde ginta hai, upar wala number, jitne tukde humne liye.
point.en: This roti is cut into 2 equal pieces, and one piece is coloured. In a fraction the bottom number counts all the roti's equal pieces, the top number the pieces we took.

pointAlt.hi: Ek laddoo se socho: tumne jitne tukde uthaye, woh ginti upar likhte hain. Neeche woh ginti jaati hai ki poora laddoo kitne barabar tukdon mein toda gaya.
pointAlt.en: Think of a laddoo: how many pieces you picked up is written on top. Below goes how many equal pieces the whole laddoo was broken into.

prompt.hi: Ek tukda rangin hai, ek bina rang ka. Toh rangin tukde ke liye kaunsa fraction likhoge?
prompt.en: One piece is coloured, one is not. So what fraction will you write for the coloured piece?

hindi.hi: Roti ke do barabar tukde hain, aur ek par rang laga hai. Rang laga tukda poori roti ka kitna hai, fraction mein?
hindi.en: The roti has two equal pieces, and one has colour on it. How much of the whole roti is the coloured piece, as a fraction?

why.hi: rangin tukda roti ke 2 barabar tukdon mein se 1 hai, toh 1/2, yaani aadha; neeche wala number 2 hai
why.en: the coloured piece is 1 of the roti's 2 equal pieces, so 1/2, a half; the bottom number is 2

whyShort.hi: roti ke 2 barabar tukdon mein se 1, yaani 1/2
whyShort.en: 1 of the roti's 2 equal pieces, so 1/2

whyAlt.hi: 1/1 ka matlab hota poori roti rangin hai, par roti ka ek tukda toh bina rang ka hai
whyAlt.en: 1/1 would mean the whole roti is coloured, but one piece of the roti has no colour

simpler.hi: Roti ke saare tukde ungli se gino, phir sirf rang wale. Dono gintiyan fraction mein kahan jaati hain, yeh socho.
simpler.en: Count all the roti's pieces with your finger, then only the coloured ones. Think where the two counts go in the fraction.

simpler.hi: Roti ke dono tukde ek jitne hain, isliye dono ka naam ek hi hai. Woh naam is baat se banta hai ki roti kitne tukdon mein kati.
simpler.en: The roti's two pieces are the same size, so both have the same name. That name comes from how many pieces the roti is cut into.

explain.convey: a pizza and a cake, 3 pieces each, but only same-size pieces get the name third: the cake's equal pieces are each 1/3; the pizza has one big and two small pieces → asked: is a small one a third

viewCaption.hi: Pizza aur cake ab do patti ban gaye hain, pizza pehli patti mein aur cake doosri mein. Dono pattiyon ke teen-teen tukde hain.
viewCaption.en: The pizza and the cake are now two strips, the pizza first and the cake second. Each strip has three pieces.

point.hi: Yeh pizza aur yeh cake, dono ke 3-3 tukde. Cake ke teeno tukde barabar hain, toh wahan har tukda ek-tihaai hai, 1/3. Pizza mein ek tukda bada hai aur do chhote.
point.en: Here's a pizza and a cake, 3 pieces each. The cake's three pieces are equal, so there each piece is one-third, 1/3. The pizza has one big piece and two small ones.

pointAlt.hi: Ek-tihaai ki jaanch aise hoti hai: ek tukda utha kar baaki do tukdon se milao. Cake ka har tukda baaki dono se bilkul milta hai, isliye cake ka har tukda 1/3 hai. Yahi jaanch pizza ke tukdon par karke dekho.
pointAlt.en: This is how you test for a third: pick up one piece and hold it against the other two. Each cake piece matches the other two exactly, so each cake piece is 1/3. Try the same test on the pizza's pieces.

prompt.hi: Pizza ka ek chhota tukda lo. Kya woh pizza ka ek-tihaai hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Take a small piece of the pizza. Is it one-third of the pizza, yes or no?

reask.hi: Kya pizza ka ek chhota tukda poore pizza ka ek-tihaai hai?
reask.en: Is a small piece of the pizza one-third of the whole pizza?

accept: no, the pieces are not equal

why.hi: 3 tukde barabar nahi, toh gin kar 1/3 nahi keh sakte; bada tukda aadha pizza hai, chhota 1/3 se chhota
why.en: the 3 pieces are unequal, so counting can't say 1/3; the big piece is half, so a small one is under 1/3

whyShort.hi: tukde barabar nahi, aur chhota tukda 1/3 se chhota hai
whyShort.en: unequal pieces, and a small one is under 1/3

whyAlt.hi: chhota tukda ek-tihaai hota toh teen chhote tukde milkar poora pizza bana dete, par yahan ek tukda bada hai
whyAlt.en: if a small piece were a third, three small pieces would make the whole pizza, but here one piece is big

simpler.hi: Pizza ka chhota tukda uske bade tukde ke saath milaa kar dekho. Phir cake ke tukdon ko aapas mein milao.
simpler.en: Hold the pizza's small piece against its big piece. Then compare the cake's pieces with each other.

viewCaption.hi: Pehli patti pizza hai: uska ek tukda lamba hai aur do chhote. Doosri patti, cake, ke teeno tukde ek jitne lambe hain.
viewCaption.en: The first strip is the pizza: one of its pieces is long and two are short. The second strip, the cake, has three pieces of the same length.

simpler.hi: Ek-tihaai ka naam do baaton se milta hai: poori cheez ke 3 tukde, aur teeno ek jitne bade. Cake mein yeh dono baatein hain.
simpler.en: The name one-third needs two things: the whole in 3 pieces, and all three the same size. The cake has both.

explain.convey: drawn circle in 3 equal parts → one part = one-third = 1/3; bottom 3 = all the equal parts of the whole

viewCaption.hi: Wahi circle ab patti mein khula hai: teen barabar tukde, ek mein rang, do bina rang ke.
viewCaption.en: The same circle is laid out as a strip: three equal pieces, one coloured, two uncoloured.

point.hi: Is circle ke 3 barabar tukde hain, ek mein rang. Yeh rangin tukda ek-tihaai hai, 1/3. Neeche wala number 3 isliye hai, kyunki poore circle ke 3 barabar tukde hain.
point.en: This circle has 3 equal pieces, one coloured. That coloured piece is one-third, 1/3. The bottom number is 3 because the whole circle has 3 equal pieces.

pointAlt.hi: Teen dost ek roti barabar baantein, toh har ek ko roti ka 1/3 milta hai. Roti 3 barabar tukdon mein kati, isliye neeche 3; ek tukda mila, isliye upar 1.
pointAlt.en: If three friends share a roti equally, each gets 1/3 of the roti. The roti was cut into 3 equal pieces, so 3 at the bottom; one piece each, so 1 on top.

prompt.hi: Ek aur tukde mein rang bharo. Ab rangin tukdon ka fraction kya hoga?
prompt.en: Colour one more piece. What will the fraction of the coloured pieces be now?

reask.hi: 3 barabar tukdon wale circle mein 1 tukda rangin hai; ek aur rangne par, rangin tukde poore circle ka kaunsa fraction honge?
reask.en: In a circle of 3 equal pieces with 1 coloured, if one more is coloured, what fraction of the whole circle are the coloured pieces?

why.hi: circle 3 barabar tukdon mein bata hai aur ab 2 mein rang hai, yaani 2/3
why.en: the circle has 3 equal pieces and 2 are coloured now, so 2/3

whyShort.hi: 3 barabar tukdon mein se 2 mein rang, yaani 2/3
whyShort.en: 2 of the 3 equal pieces are coloured, so 2/3

whyAlt.hi: 2/1 ka matlab hota do poore circle, par rangin tukde toh ek hi circle ke andar hain, aur uske saare tukde bhi nahi
whyAlt.en: 2/1 would mean two whole circles, but the coloured pieces are inside one circle, and not even all of its pieces

simpler.hi: Pehle gino ki circle ke kul kitne tukde hain: yeh ginti neeche wala number hai. Phir socho, ek aur tukda rangne ke baad kitne rangin honge: woh ginti upar wala number.
simpler.en: First count how many pieces the circle has in all: that count is the bottom number. Then think how many will be coloured once one more is: that count is the top number.

simpler.hi: Ek kaagaz ko teen barabar tukdon mein modo, aur ek tukde par rang karo. Woh rangin tukda kaagaz ka 1/3 hai.
simpler.en: Fold a sheet of paper into three equal pieces, and colour one piece. That coloured piece is 1/3 of the paper.

explain.convey: strip in 8 equal parts, 1 shaded → one-eighth = 1/8; bottom = all 8 parts of the whole, never the 7 unshaded parts left → not 1/7; then an error spot on a second strip (a ribbon of 6 equal pieces, 1 cut off for Raju, 5 left): Raju's 1/5 is judged → no, 1/6

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti yahan ek number line ban gayi hai, 0 se 1 tak, aath barabar gap. Pehle gap ke ant mein 1/8 ka mark hai.
viewCaption.en: The strip has become a number line here, from 0 to 1, eight equal gaps. At the end of the first gap is the 1/8 mark.

point.hi: Is patti ka rangin tukda 1/8 hai: 8 saare tukde ginta hai, bache hue 7 nahi.
point.en: This strip's coloured piece is 1/8: the 8 counts all the pieces, not the 7 left over.

pointAlt.hi: Ek kitaab ke 8 barabar panne socho, aur ek panna phat gaya. Woh panna kitaab ka 1/8 tha, kyunki kitaab 8 pannon se bani thi; bache hue 7 panne uska naam nahi badalte.
pointAlt.en: Picture a book of 8 equal pages, and one page tore out. That page was 1/8 of the book, because the book was made of 8 pages; the 7 pages left do not change its name.

prompt.hi: Doosri patti ke 6 barabar tukde hain. Raju ne 1 tukda liya, 5 bache. Raju kehta hai usne 1/5 liya, kyunki 5 bache. Raju ne asal mein kaunsa fraction liya?
prompt.en: The second strip has 6 equal pieces. Raju took 1 piece, 5 were left. Raju says he took 1/5, because 5 were left. What fraction did Raju really take?

reask.hi: 6 barabar tukdon wali patti se Raju ne 1 tukda kaata aur 5 bache, toh Raju ne patti ka kaunsa fraction liya?
reask.en: Raju cut 1 piece from a strip of 6 equal pieces and 5 were left: what fraction of the strip did Raju take?

why.hi: Raju ka tukda patti ke 6 tukdon mein se 1 hai, toh 1/6, 1/5 nahi; bache hue 5 tukde naam nahi badalte
why.en: Raju's piece is 1 of the strip's 6 pieces, so 1/6, not 1/5; the 5 pieces left do not change the name

whyShort.hi: Raju ka tukda 6 tukdon mein se 1, yaani 1/6
whyShort.en: Raju's piece is 1 of 6 pieces, so 1/6

whyAlt.hi: 1/5 hota toh aise sirf 5 tukde poori patti bana dete; par patti mein bache 5 ke saath Raju ka tukda bhi tha, toh Raju ne sirf bache hue gine
whyAlt.en: if it were 1/5, just 5 such pieces would make the whole strip; but the strip had Raju's piece as well as the 5 left, so Raju counted only the ones left

simpler.hi: Kaatne se pehle doosri patti mein kitne tukde the, woh gino. Phir use Raju ke 5 se milao.
simpler.en: Count how many pieces the second strip had before the cut. Then compare that with Raju's 5.

viewCaption.hi: Raju wali patti yahan number line ke neeche hai: 0 se 1 tak, chhe barabar gap. Line ke upar wahi aath gap hain, aur un par 1/8 ka mark.
viewCaption.en: Raju's strip is below the number line here: 0 to 1, six equal gaps. Above the line are the same eight gaps, with the 1/8 mark on them.

simpler.hi: Bina rang ke tukde gino, 7, phir rangin tukda bhi jodo, 8: 1/8 ka 8 yahi poori ginti hai.
simpler.en: Count the uncoloured pieces, 7, then add the coloured piece too, 8: the 8 of 1/8 is this full count.

problem.hi: Ek lambi barfi ke 5 barabar tukde kiye, aur 3 tukde kha liye. Is baar rangin tukde woh hain jo plate par bache.
problem.en: A long barfi was cut into 5 equal pieces, and 3 pieces were eaten. This time the coloured pieces are the ones left on the plate.

problemAlt.hi: Yeh roti wale sawaal jaisa hai: ek ginti poori barfi ke tukdon ki, ek ginti plate par bache tukdon ki. Dono se fraction banega.
problemAlt.en: This is like the roti question: one count of the whole barfi's pieces, one count of the pieces left on the plate. The fraction comes from the two.

simpler.hi: Pehle ek chhoti baat yaad karo: roti ke 2 barabar tukdon mein se 1 bacha, toh roti ka 1/2 bacha. Barfi ko bhi isi tarah socho.
simpler.en: First recall a small one: if 1 of a roti's 2 equal pieces is left, 1/2 of the roti is left. Think of the barfi the same way.

givens.hi: Hamare paas do cheezein hain: poori barfi ke tukde, aur khaye hue tukde.
givens.en: We know two things: the pieces of the whole barfi, and the pieces eaten.

find.en: the pieces left, as a fraction

reask.hi: 5 barabar tukdon wali barfi ke 3 tukde khaane ke baad, bache tukdon ke fraction ka neeche wala number kya hoga?
reask.en: After 3 pieces of a barfi of 5 equal pieces are eaten, what is the bottom number of the fraction for the pieces left?

right.hi: Haan, 5: barfi 5 barabar tukdon mein kati thi.
right.en: Yes, 5: the barfi was cut into 5 equal pieces.

told.hi: Neeche wala number saare tukde ginta hai, yaani 5, kyunki khaane se pehle barfi 5 barabar tukdon mein kati thi.
told.en: The bottom number counts all the pieces, that's 5, because before anyone ate, the barfi was cut into 5 equal pieces.

do.hi: Neeche wala number poori barfi ke tukde ginta hai
do.en: The bottom number counts the whole barfi's pieces

why.hi: barfi khaane se pehle 5 barabar tukdon mein kati thi
why.en: before anyone ate, the barfi was cut into 5 equal pieces

simpler.hi: Khaane se pehle wali poori barfi yaad karo, jab ek bhi tukda khaya nahi gaya tha. Neeche wala number usi barfi ki baat karta hai.
simpler.en: Remember the whole barfi before a single piece was eaten. The bottom number is about that barfi.

prompt.hi: Tumhari baari: plate par bache tukde poori barfi ka kaunsa fraction hain?
prompt.en: Your turn: what fraction of the whole barfi are the pieces left on the plate?

reask.en: After 3 pieces of a barfi of 5 equal pieces are eaten, what fraction of the whole barfi are the pieces left on the plate?

why.hi: barfi ke 5 barabar tukde the aur unmein se 2 bache, isliye neeche wala number 5 aur upar wala 2
why.en: the barfi had 5 equal pieces and 2 are left, so the bottom number is 5 and the top 2

whyAlt.hi: 2/3 ka matlab hota 3 tukdon mein se 2; par plate ke 2 tukde khaye hue 3 mein se nahi aaye, woh poori barfi ke tukdon mein se hain
whyAlt.en: 2/3 would mean 2 out of 3 pieces; but the 2 pieces on the plate did not come out of the 3 eaten, they are from the whole barfi's pieces

simpler.hi: Pehle gino plate par kitne tukde bache; woh ginti upar jaati hai, aur neeche saare 5.
simpler.en: First count how many pieces are left on the plate; that count goes on top, and all 5 at the bottom.

answer.hi: bache hue tukde barfi ka 2/5 hain

why.hi: 5 barabar tukdon mein se 2 bache; neeche wala number 5 hai, saare tukde, khaye hue 3 nahi

viewCaption.en: The same barfi is now drawn like a circle: five equal pieces, two of them coloured. The coloured pieces are the ones left on the plate.

hindi.hi: Laddoo ke 3 tukde bane, sab ek size ke nahi. Sabse bada tukda poore laddoo ka 1/2 hai ya 1/3?
hindi.en: The laddoo broke into 3 pieces, not all one size. Is the biggest piece 1/2 of the whole laddoo or 1/3?

did.hi: toote laddoo ka bada tukda poore laddoo se milaya

why.hi: laddoo ke 3 tukdon mein bada tukda theek aadha hai, yaani 1/2; dono chhote milkar baaki aadha
why.en: of the laddoo's 3 pieces, the big one is exactly half, 1/2; the two small ones make the other half

whyShort.hi: bada tukda theek aadha laddoo hai, yaani 1/2
whyShort.en: the big piece is exactly half the laddoo, 1/2

whyAlt.hi: teen tukde gine, par teeno ek jitne nahi; socho, bade tukde jaise kitne tukde milkar poora laddoo bana dete

prompt.hi: Tumhari chocolate ke 12 barabar tukde hain. Tumne usmein se 1/12 kha liya. Ab kitne tukde bache?

reask.hi: 12 barabar tukdon wali chocolate ka 1/12 khaya gaya, toh kitne tukde bache?

viewCaption.hi: Wahi chocolate ab ek circle mein hai, 12 barabar tukdon mein. Abhi kisi tukde mein rang nahi bhara.

why.hi: 1/12 ka matlab chocolate ke 12 barabar tukdon mein se 1 khaya; 12 mein se 1 gaya, toh 11 bache
why.en: 1/12 means 1 of the chocolate's 12 equal pieces was eaten; 1 of 12 went, so 11 are left

whyShort.hi: 12 tukdon mein se 1 khaya, toh 11 bache
whyShort.en: 1 of 12 pieces was eaten, so 11 are left

whyAlt.hi: 12 toh khaane se pehle ki ginti hai; jo tukda khaya, woh ab chocolate mein nahi hai

answerViewCaption.hi: Circle ke 12 barabar tukdon mein se ek mein rang hai, woh khaya hua 1/12 hai. Baaki 11 tukde bache hain.
answerViewCaption.en: One of the circle's 12 equal pieces is coloured, that is the 1/12 eaten. The other 11 pieces are left.

simpler.hi: Socho, 1/12 ka neeche wala number kya ginta hai, aur upar wala kya ginta hai.

prompt.hi: Cake ke 4 tukde hue: ek bada aur teen ek jitne chhote. Ek chhota tukda cake ke 1/4 se kam hai, 1/4 ke barabar hai, ya 1/4 se zyada?
prompt.en: A cake was cut into 4 pieces: one big and three equal small ones. Is one small piece less than 1/4 of the cake, equal to it, or more than 1/4?

hindi.hi: Cake ke 4 tukde hain: ek mota, teen ek jaise patle. Ek patla tukda 1/4 se kam hai, theek 1/4 hai, ya zyada?
hindi.en: The cake has 4 pieces: one thick, three alike and thin. Is one thin piece less than 1/4, exactly 1/4, or more?

reask.hi: Ek bade aur teen ek jitne chhote tukdon wale cake mein, ek chhota tukda 1/4 se kam hai, barabar hai, ya zyada?
reask.en: In a cake of one big and three equal small pieces, is one small piece less than 1/4, equal to it, or more?

did.hi: chhote-bade tukdon wale cake ka chhota tukda 1/4 se milaya
did.en: compared a small piece of an uneven cake with 1/4

viewCaption.hi: Cake ab ek patti ki shakal mein hai: ek lamba tukda aur teen chhote tukde, sab ek hi patti mein.
viewCaption.en: The cake is now shaped as one strip: one long piece and three short pieces, all in the one strip.

why.hi: chaaron tukde milkar poora cake hain; teen chhote barabar hain aur bada unse bada, toh har chhota tukda 1/4 se kam
why.en: four pieces make the cake; three small ones are equal and the big one bigger, so each small one is under 1/4

whyShort.hi: teen chhote barabar, bada unse bada: chhota 1/4 se kam
whyShort.en: three equal small ones, a bigger one: each under 1/4

whyAlt.hi: ek chhota tukda 1/4 ke barabar hota toh aise chaar tukde poora cake bana dete; par yahan chautha tukda unse bada hai, phir bhi sab milkar ek hi cake hain
whyAlt.en: if a small piece were equal to 1/4, four such pieces would make the whole cake; but here the fourth piece is bigger than them, and all of them together still make just one cake

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri patti mein chaar barabar tukde hain, aur rangin tukda 1/4 hai. Pehli patti ka chhota tukda us rangin tukde se chhota hai, isliye 1/4 se kam.
answerViewCaption.en: The second strip has four equal pieces, and the coloured piece is 1/4. A small piece of the first strip is shorter than that coloured piece, so less than 1/4.

simpler.hi: Socho, chaaron tukde barabar hote toh har ek kitna hota. Phir dekho, bade tukde ne baaki teen ke liye kitni jagah chhodi.
simpler.en: Think how big each piece would be if all four were equal. Then see how much room the big piece left for the other three.

ladder.why: more than one part taken → 3 of 4 equal parts = 3/4; top number beyond 1

say.hi: Rassi ke 3 tukde hain, par ek lamba aur do chhote: inhe gin kar ek-tihaai nahi keh sakte. Kaagaz ke dono tukde ek jaise hain, toh har tukda aadha hai.
say.en: The rope has 3 pieces, but one long and two short: we can't call them thirds by counting them. The paper's two pieces are alike, so each piece is a half.

viewCaption.hi: Rassi aur kaagaz yahan do circle ban gaye hain: rassi ka ek tukda bada aur do chhote, kaagaz ke dono tukde ek jitne.
viewCaption.en: The rope and the paper are two circles here: the rope has one big piece and two small ones, the paper's two pieces are the same.

sayAlt.hi: Ek seb ko 3 tukdon mein kaato, ek mota aur do patle. Tukde 3 hain, par barabar nahi, isliye 3 gin kar inhe ek-tihaai nahi keh sakte.
sayAlt.en: Cut an apple into 3 pieces, one thick and two thin. There are 3 pieces, but they are not equal, so we can't call them thirds by counting 3.

viewCaption.hi: Seb yahan ek patti ban gaya hai: ek mota tukda aur do patle tukde.
viewCaption.en: The apple is a strip here: one thick piece and two thin pieces.

simpler.hi: Chhote-bade tukde gin kar naam nahi rakhte; pehle dekho, tukde ek size ke hain ya nahi, jaise kaagaz ke do aadhe.
simpler.en: You can't name big-and-small pieces by counting them; first check whether the pieces are the same size, like the paper's two halves.

prompt.hi: Roti ke 2 tukde hue, ek bada, ek chhota. Bada tukda aadhe se kam hai, aadha, ya zyada?
prompt.en: A roti tears into 2 pieces, one big, one small. Is the big piece less than half, a half, or more?

viewCaption.hi: Patti mein roti ke do tukde dekho: lamba tukda ek taraf, chhota doosri taraf, aur dono milkar poori roti.
viewCaption.en: Look at the roti's two pieces in the strip: the long one on one side, the short one on the other, and together the whole roti.

why.hi: do tukde barabar hon tabhi har ek aadha hota; yahan bada tukda chhote se bada hai, toh aadhe se zyada
why.en: two pieces are halves only when equal; here the bigger one is more than the smaller, so it is more than half

whyShort.hi: tukde barabar nahi; bada tukda aadhe se zyada hai
whyShort.en: unequal pieces; the big one is over half

whyAlt.hi: aadha tab hota jab dono tukde ek jitne hote; yahan dono ek jitne nahi hain
whyAlt.en: it would be a half only if both pieces were the same size; here they are not the same size

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri patti do barabar aadhon mein hai. Pehli patti ka lamba tukda us aadhe se aage tak jaata hai, isliye woh aadhe se zyada hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The second strip is in two equal halves. The first strip's long piece goes past that half, so it is more than half.

simpler.hi: Roti ke beech mein ek line socho jo use do barabar aadhon mein baante. Ab dekho, bada tukda us line par rukta hai ya usse aage jaata hai.

remediation.move: own board (a chocolate of 10 equal pieces, 3 eaten); name the piece first: in a whole of equal pieces the bottom number says how many equal pieces the whole was cut into, eaten or left → the top only counts the pieces asked about; then the then-card's chocolate of 4 pieces with 2 coloured (eaten): Pinky's 2/4 or Golu's 2/2

say.hi: Is chocolate ke 10 barabar tukde hain, aur rangin 3 khaye gaye. Neeche wala number saare 10 ginta hai; khaane se woh ginti nahi badalti.
say.en: This chocolate has 10 equal pieces, and the 3 coloured ones were eaten. The bottom number counts all 10; eating doesn't change that count.

sayAlt.hi: Ek roti 8 barabar tukdon mein kati socho. Usmein se 3 kha lo ya 5, roti phir bhi 8 tukdon se hi bani thi, isliye neeche wala number 8 hi rehta hai. Upar wala number woh tukde ginta hai jinki baat ho rahi hai, yahan khaye hue.
sayAlt.en: Picture a roti cut into 8 equal pieces. Eat 3 of them or 5, the roti was still made of 8 pieces, so the bottom number stays 8. The top number counts the pieces we are talking about, here the eaten ones.

viewCaption.hi: Roti yahan ek patti ban gayi hai: aath barabar tukde, aur rangin tukde khaye hue.
viewCaption.en: The roti is a strip here: eight equal pieces, and the coloured pieces are eaten.

viewCaption.hi: Wahi chocolate ab ek circle mein hai: das barabar tukde, teen mein rang. Rangin tukde khaye hue hain.
viewCaption.en: The same chocolate is now a circle: ten equal pieces, three coloured. The coloured pieces are the eaten ones.

simpler.hi: Khaane se pehle wali poori chocolate ke saare tukde neeche wale number mein jaate hain. Upar wale number mein sirf woh tukde, jinki baat poochhi gayi hai.
simpler.en: All the pieces of the whole chocolate, before anyone ate, go in the bottom number. The top number holds only the pieces the question is about.

prompt.hi: Doosri chocolate ke rangin tukde khaye gaye. Pinky kehti hai 2/4, Golu kehta hai 2/2. Kaun sahi hai, Pinky ya Golu?
prompt.en: The coloured pieces of the other chocolate were eaten. Pinky says 2/4, Golu says 2/2. Who is right, Pinky or Golu?

hindi.hi: Khaye hue tukdon ka fraction likhna hai: 2/4 theek baithta hai ya 2/2?
hindi.en: We have to write the fraction for the eaten pieces: does 2/4 fit, or 2/2?

reask.hi: Board ki chocolate ke jo tukde khaye gaye, unke liye Pinky ka 2/4 theek hai ya Golu ka 2/2?

viewCaption.en: Here the chocolate is drawn like a circle: four equal pieces, two coloured, two uncoloured. The coloured pieces are the ones that were eaten.

why.hi: 4 barabar tukdon mein se 2 khaye, toh 2/4; neeche wala number saare 4 tukde ginta hai, bache hue 2 nahi

whyShort.hi: 4 barabar tukdon mein se 2 khaye, yaani 2/4

whyAlt.hi: 2/2 ka matlab poori chocolate hoti, par poori chocolate toh khayi nahi gayi; 2/2 kehne wale ne neeche chocolate ke saare tukde nahi gine

answerViewCaption.hi: Number line par 0 se 1 tak chaar barabar gap hain, aur 2/4 ka mark do gap par hai. Khaye hue 2 tukde 4 mein se 2 hain, isliye 2/4.

simpler.hi: Board par chocolate ke saare tukde gino, rangin bhi aur bina rang ke bhi. Phir sirf rangin tukde gino.
simpler.en: Count all the chocolate's pieces on the board, coloured and uncoloured. Then count just the coloured ones.

bridgeToNext.en: Next, in place of one thing we take lots of things, like laddoos, mangoes or marbles, and find fractions of them. The rule stays the same: everything equal.

simpler.hi: Ab bahut saari cheezon ka fraction dekhenge.
simpler.en: Now we look at fractions of lots of things.

covered.hi: Phir group ka fraction: 1/3 ke liye cheezein 3 barabar group mein baanti, aur ek group gina.
covered.en: Then a group's fraction: for 1/3, we shared the things into 3 equal groups and counted one group.

hook.convey: 12 laddoos (or 12 biscuits), 2 sharers, fair share → each share = half of the set; a fraction can be of a whole set, the set being the one whole

use.hi: Kitchen ke dibbe mein 12 laddoo hain, aur khaane wale tum do; kisi ko kam nahi milna chahiye.
use.en: There are 12 laddoos in the kitchen tin, and two of you to eat them; nobody should get less.

use.hi: Cricket match ke baad 2 bhookhe bachche ghar aaye; dibbe ke 12 laddoo dono ko ek jitne milne chahiye.
use.en: After a cricket match 2 hungry children come home; the tin's 12 laddoos must go to both equally.

explain.convey: the tin's 12 laddoos, loose on the board → half = 2 equal groups, one group's count is the half; check: both shares together make all 12 again; the ask finds the half

viewCaption.hi: Board par 12 laddoo 3 qatar mein rakhe hain, har qatar mein chaar. Har laddoo ka apna khana hai.
viewCaption.en: The board has 12 laddoos in three rows, four in each row. Each laddoo has its own box.

point.hi: Do bachche yeh 12 laddoo barabar baantenge. Aadha matlab: dono ke paas ek jitne laddoo, aur ek bachche ke laddoo hi aadha. Dono ke laddoo jodkar dekho, toh saare 12 wapas mil jaate hain.
point.en: Two children will share these 12 laddoos equally. Half means: both have the same number, and one child's laddoos are the half. Put both children's laddoos together and all 12 are back.

pointAlt.hi: Aadha karne ka ek aur tareeka: laddoo ek-ek karke do group mein baari-baari rakho, jab tak sab khatam na ho jaayein. Dono group mein ek jitne laddoo aayenge, aur ek group ke laddoo hi aadha hain.
pointAlt.en: Another way to halve: put the laddoos one at a time into two groups, taking turns, until they are all gone. Both groups get the same number, and one group's laddoos are the half.

prompt.hi: 12 laddoo ka aadha kitne laddoo hai?

hindi.hi: 12 laddoo do bachchon mein barabar baanto. Ek bachche ko kitne milenge?

reask.hi: 12 laddoo ke aadhe mein kitne laddoo aate hain?

whyShort.hi: 2 barabar group, har ek mein 6 laddoo
whyShort.en: 2 equal groups, 6 laddoos in each

whyAlt.hi: aadha matlab 12 laddoo ke do barabar group banana; jawab group ki ginti nahi, ek group ke laddoo hain
whyAlt.en: half means making two equal groups of the 12 laddoos; the answer is not the number of groups but the laddoos in one group

simpler.hi: Board par laddoo teen qatar mein hain, har qatar mein 4. Har qatar ko beech se do-do mein baanto, aur ek taraf ke laddoo gino.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh wahi 12 laddoo hain: 3 qatarein, har qatar mein chaar. Inhe ek-ek karke do group mein rakhna hai.
viewCaption.en: These are the same 12 laddoos, three rows of four. They are to go into two groups one at a time.

pictureCaption.hi: Yeh baantne ki pehli baari hai: do group, aur har group mein ek laddoo. Isi tarah baari-baari ek-ek laddoo daalte raho, jab tak saare 12 laddoo khatam na ho jaayein.
pictureCaption.en: This is the first turn of sharing: two groups, one laddoo in each. Keep dropping in one laddoo at a time, taking turns, until all 12 laddoos are used up.

simpler.hi: Ek chhoti ginti se socho: chaar laddoo do bachchon mein barabar bate, toh dono ko do-do mile. Do aur do jodo toh chaar wapas, aur ek bachche ke do laddoo hi chaar ka aadha hain.
simpler.en: Think with a small count: four laddoos shared equally by two children gives each two. Put two and two together and the four are back, and one child's two laddoos are half of four.

explain.convey: 24 mangoes shown as 1/6 (6 equal groups of 4): bottom 6 = share into 6 equal groups, top 1 = take one group; then 1/3 of the same 24: bottom 3 = 3 equal groups, one group's count is the answer

viewCaption.hi: Chhe group ab ek jaal mein hain: har qatar ek group hai, aur har qatar mein chaar aam.
viewCaption.en: The six groups are now in one grid: each row is a group, with four mangoes in each row.

point.hi: 24 aam 6 barabar group mein hain, har group mein 4: ek group 24 ka 1/6 hai. Chhote group jodkar bade barabar group bhi bante hain: teen-teen jodo, toh har bada group 24 ka 1/2 hai.
point.en: The 24 mangoes are in 6 equal groups of 4: one group is 1/6 of 24. Small groups also join into bigger equal groups: join them three at a time, and each big group is 1/2 of 24.

pointAlt.hi: Socho, 6 bachche yeh 24 aam barabar baantein: har bachche ko ek group milta hai, 4 aam. Yahi 24 ka 1/6 hai.
pointAlt.en: Picture 6 children sharing these 24 mangoes equally: each child gets one group, 4 mangoes. That is 1/6 of 24.

prompt.hi: 24 ka 1/3 lena hai. Board ke 6 group mein se kitne group uthaoge?
prompt.en: We want 1/3 of 24. How many of the board's 6 groups do you pick up?

reask.hi: 24 aam ke 6 barabar group mein se, 24 ka 1/3 lene ke liye kitne group uthaoge?
reask.en: Of the 6 equal groups of 24 mangoes, how many groups do you pick up to take 1/3 of 24?

why.hi: 6 group ko jod kar 3 barabar bade group banao: har bade group mein 2 group, yaani 8 aam

whyShort.hi: 6 group se 3 bade group, har ek mein 2

whyAlt.hi: ek group mein 4 aam hain, par yahan group ginne hain; 1/3 mein utne group aate hain jitne teen baar lene par poore 6 group ban jaayein
whyAlt.en: one group has 4 mangoes, but here we count groups; 1/3 holds as many groups as make all 6 groups when taken three times

simpler.hi: 6 group ko 3 bachchon mein ek-ek karke baanto. Ek bachche ke paas kitne group aaye, woh gino.
simpler.en: Hand out the 6 groups to 3 children, one at a time. Count how many groups one child gets.

viewCaption.hi: Jaal mein chhe qatarein hain, har qatar ek group, aur kul 24 aam. Ek qatar uthana matlab ek group uthana.
viewCaption.en: The grid has six rows, each row a group, and 24 mangoes in all. Picking up one row means picking up one group.

simpler.hi: Group-group karke 4 aam jodte jao jab tak 24 na ho jaayein: aise 6 group lagte hain. Isliye ek group, 4 aam, 24 ka 1/6 hai.
simpler.en: Keep adding 4 mangoes, group by group, until you reach 24: it takes 6 such groups. So one group, 4 mangoes, is 1/6 of 24.

viewCaption.hi: Do group ab ek jaal mein hain: do qatarein, har qatar mein das kanche.

point.hi: Yeh 20 kanche 10-10 ke 2 barabar group mein hain, toh 10 kanche 20 ka aadha hain, 1/2. Yahan neeche wala number 2 barabar group ginta hai.
point.en: These 20 marbles are in 2 equal groups of 10, so 10 marbles are half of 20, 1/2. Here the bottom number 2 counts the equal groups.

pointAlt.hi: Ise paison se socho: 20 rupaye ke 10-10 rupaye ke dher banao, toh 2 dher bante hain, isliye 10 rupaye 20 ka 1/2 hain. Jab pata ho ki ek dher mein kitne rupaye hain, toh gino ki kitne dher bante hain; ek dher utne dheron mein se ek hai.
pointAlt.en: Think of it with money: make piles of 10 rupees out of 20 rupees and you get 2 piles, so 10 rupees is 1/2 of 20. When you know a pile's size, count the piles; one pile is one of that many piles.

prompt.hi: Socho, yeh 20 kanche kuch bachchon mein barabar bate, aur har bachche ko 5 mile. 5 kanche saare 20 kanchon ka kaunsa fraction hain?
prompt.en: Imagine these 20 marbles were shared equally among some children, and each child got 5. What fraction of all 20 marbles are 5 marbles?

why.hi: 4 × 5 = 20: 20 ke 4 barabar group, har ek mein 5; yeh 1/4 hai, 5/20 bhi sahi

whyShort.hi: 4 × 5 = 20, toh 4 bachche, har ek ka 1/4

whyAlt.hi: 1/5 mein 5 neeche gaya, par 5 toh ek bachche ke kanche hain; gino ki 20 kanche kitne bachchon mein barabar bate
whyAlt.en: In 1/5 the 5 went to the bottom, but 5 is one child's marbles; count how many children the 20 marbles were shared among equally

simpler.hi: Gino, 20 tak pahunchne ke liye 5 kitni baar jodna padta hai. Utne hi barabar group bante hain.
simpler.en: Count how many times you add 5 to reach 20. That is how many equal groups there are.

viewCaption.hi: Jaal mein 20 kanche hain: do qatarein, har qatar mein 10. Har kanche ka apna khana hai, toh gin kar group banana aasaan hai.
viewCaption.en: The grid holds 20 marbles, two rows of ten. Each marble has its own box, so grouping them by counting is easy.

simpler.hi: Dono group ke kanche jodo: 10 aur 10, poore 20 kanche. Do barabar group saare kanche bana dete hain, isliye har group kanchon ka aadha hai.
simpler.en: Add the two groups' marbles: 10 and 10, all 20 marbles. Two equal groups make up all the marbles, so each group is half of them.

prompt.en: Share the 15 pencils into 3 equal groups, or make groups of 3?

reask.hi: 15 pencil ka 1/3 nikaalne ke liye kaunsa theek hai: 15 pencil ke 3 barabar group banana, ya 3-3 pencil ke group banana?
reask.en: To find 1/3 of 15 pencils, which is right: making 3 equal groups of the 15, or making groups of 3 pencils?

right.hi: Sahi: 15 pencil ke 3 barabar group banane hain, aur ek group lena hai.
right.en: Right: the 15 pencils go into 3 equal groups, and one group is taken.

told.hi: 1/3 ka neeche wala 3 group ginta hai, toh 15 pencil ko 3 barabar group mein baantna hai, aur ek group lena hai.
told.en: The 3 at the bottom of 1/3 counts the groups, so the 15 pencils are to be shared into 3 equal groups, and one group taken.

do.hi: 1/3 ka neeche wala number group ginta hai
do.en: The bottom number of 1/3 counts the groups

steps.result: 3 barabar group, unmein se 1 group lena

why.hi: 3-3 ke group banate toh 5 group bante, aur ek group 1/5 hota
why.en: groups of 3 would make 5 groups, and one group would be 1/5

simpler.hi: Dono tareeke socho: 3-3 ke group banane par kitne group bante hain, aur 1/3 ka neeche wala 3 kya ginta hai.
simpler.en: Think through both ways: how many groups you get with groups of 3, and what the 3 at the bottom of 1/3 counts.

prompt.hi: Tumhari baari: ek group mein kitni pencil aayengi?
prompt.en: Your turn: how many pencils go in one group?

reask.hi: 15 pencil 3 barabar group mein baanto, toh ek group mein kitni pencil aayengi?
reask.en: Share 15 pencils into 3 equal groups: how many pencils go in one group?

why.hi: 3 group mein 5-5 pencil rakhne se poori 15 ho jaati hain, 3 × 5 = 15
why.en: 5 pencils in each of 3 groups makes all 15, since 3 × 5 = 15

whyAlt.hi: 3 toh group ki ginti hai; ek group mein utni pencil aati hain jitni teen baar jodne par 15 ban jaayein
whyAlt.en: 3 is the number of groups; one group holds as many pencils as make 15 when added three times

simpler.hi: Pencil ek-ek karke 3 group mein rakho, baari-baari. Saari khatam, toh ek group gin lo.
simpler.en: Put the pencils one at a time into 3 groups, taking turns. When they are gone, count one group.

viewCaption.hi: Board par 15 pencil hain, har pencil ka apna khana. Inhe baari-baari ek-ek karke 3 group mein rakho, jab tak saari pencil khatam na ho jaayein.
viewCaption.en: The board has 15 pencils, each in its own box. Put them into 3 groups one at a time, taking turns, until all the pencils are used up.

pictureCaption.hi: Yeh baantne ki pehli baari hai: teen group, aur har group mein ek pencil. Isi tarah baari-baari ek-ek pencil daalte raho, jab tak saari 15 pencil khatam na ho jaayein.
pictureCaption.en: This is the first turn of sharing: three groups, one pencil in each. Keep dropping in one pencil at a time, taking turns, until all 15 pencils are used up.

why.hi: 3 group mein 5-5 pencil rakho toh poori 15 ho jaati hain, 3 × 5 = 15
why.en: 5 pencils in each of 3 groups makes all 15, 3 × 5 = 15

viewCaption.hi: Board par 15 pencil hain, har pencil ka apna khana. Abhi koi group nahi bana hai.
viewCaption.en: The board has 15 pencils, each in its own box. No group has been made yet.

prompt.hi: 18 laddoo 3 plate mein barabar rakhe gaye. Ravi ne 1 plate utha li. Ravi ke paas saare laddoo ka kaunsa fraction gaya?
prompt.en: 18 laddoos were put equally on 3 plates. Ravi picked up 1 plate. What fraction of all the laddoos went to Ravi?

hindi.hi: 18 laddoo 3 ek jaisi thaliyon mein baante, aur 1 thali Ravi ko mili. Sab laddoo mein se usko kaunsa fraction mila?
hindi.en: 18 laddoos were shared into 3 matching thalis, and Ravi got 1 thali. What fraction of all the laddoos did he get?

reask.hi: 18 laddoo 3 barabar plate mein hain aur Ravi ek plate leta hai, toh Ravi ke paas saare laddoo ka kaunsa fraction hai?
reask.en: If 18 laddoos are on 3 equal plates and Ravi takes one plate, what fraction of all the laddoos does Ravi have?

did.hi: laddoo ki jagah plate gin kar Ravi ka fraction nikala
did.en: counted plates, not laddoos, to find Ravi's fraction

viewCaption.hi: Yeh 18 laddoo ek jaal mein hain: teen qatarein, har qatar mein chhe. Har qatar ko ek plate samjho.
viewCaption.en: These 18 laddoos are in a grid: three rows, six in each. Take each row as one plate.

pictureCaption.hi: Yeh teen plate hain, aur 18 laddoo inmein barabar rakhe hain. Ravi inmein se ek plate uthata hai.
pictureCaption.en: These are the three plates, with the 18 laddoos shared equally on them. Ravi picks up one of these plates.

why.hi: 18 laddoo 3 barabar plate mein the, har plate mein 6; Ravi ne 1 plate li, yaani 1/3, 6/18 bhi sahi
why.en: the 18 laddoos were on 3 equal plates, 6 on each; Ravi took 1 plate, so 1/3, and 6/18 is right too

whyShort.hi: Ravi ne 3 barabar plate mein se 1 li
whyShort.en: Ravi took 1 of 3 equal plates

whyAlt.hi: 1/2 kehne mein neeche sirf bachi hui 2 plate gini gayi; par neeche shuru ki saari plate aati hain, Ravi wali bhi
whyAlt.en: saying 1/2 counts only the 2 plates left at the bottom; but the bottom takes all the plates from the start, Ravi's too

answerViewCaption.hi: Jaal ki teen qatarein teen plate hain, har qatar mein 6 laddoo. Ravi ne ek qatar uthayi, yaani teen mein se ek, 1/3.
answerViewCaption.en: The grid's three rows are the three plates, with 6 laddoos in each row. Ravi took one row, one of three, 1/3.

simpler.hi: Laddoo mat gino, plate gino. Pehle saari plate gino, phir Ravi ki.
simpler.en: Don't count laddoos, count plates. First count all the plates, then Ravi's.

prompt.hi: 16 kanche 4 group mein bate: 7, 3, 3 aur 3. 7 wala group saare kanchon ke 1/4 se kam hai, 1/4 ke barabar, ya 1/4 se zyada?
prompt.en: 16 marbles went into 4 groups: 7, 3, 3 and 3. Is the group of 7 less than 1/4 of all the marbles, equal to 1/4, or more than 1/4?

hindi.hi: 4 group hain: 7, 3, 3 aur 3, kul 16. 7 wala group poore 16 ka 1/4 se kam hai, theek 1/4, ya zyada?
hindi.en: There are 4 groups: 7, 3, 3 and 3, 16 in all. Is the group of 7 less than 1/4 of all 16, exactly 1/4, or more?

reask.hi: 16 kanchon ke 7, 3, 3 aur 3 wale group mein, 7 wala group saare kanchon ke 1/4 se kam hai, barabar hai, ya zyada?
reask.en: With 16 marbles in groups of 7, 3, 3 and 3, is the group of 7 less than 1/4 of all the marbles, equal to it, or more?

did.hi: 16 kanchon ka 1/4 soch kar 7 wale group ko jaancha
did.en: worked out 1/4 of 16 marbles to test the group of 7

viewCaption.hi: Har group ab ek qatar hai, aur sab qatarein ek hi kinare se shuru hoti hain: ek qatar mein 7 kanche, baaki teen mein 3-3. Har qatar ke aakhir mein uski ginti likhi hai.
viewCaption.en: Each group is now a row, and all the rows start from the same edge: one row has 7 marbles, the other three have 3 each. Each row's count is written at its end.

why.hi: charon group barabar hote toh har ek 16 ka 1/4 hota, yaani 4; 7 usse zyada hai
why.en: if all four groups were equal, each would be 1/4 of 16, that is 4; 7 is more than that

whyShort.hi: 16 ka 1/4 hai 4, aur 7 usse zyada
whyShort.en: 1/4 of 16 is 4, and 7 is more

whyAlt.hi: agar 7 kanche 1/4 hote, toh aise chaar group milkar 28 kanche bana dete; par kul kanche toh 16 hi hain
whyAlt.en: if 7 marbles were 1/4, four such groups would make 28 marbles; but there are only 16 marbles in all

simpler.hi: Socho, 16 kanche 4 barabar group mein hote toh har group mein kitne kanche hote. Phir use 7 se milao.
simpler.en: Think how many marbles each group would hold if the 16 were in 4 equal groups. Then compare that with 7.

ladder.why: thirds of a set as sharing among 3 friends → 3 equal groups
one-third in a word problem without the sharing story spelled out
quarters of a bigger set → 4 equal groups
name the fraction of the set and find the amount, both
two fractions of the same set in one problem → half and quarter

remediation.move: own board (5 bags of 7, one given away): count bags not bananas; the bag given is one of 5, the bags left do not rename it; then the then-card's 30 bananas in 6 bags on its own board: is the bag given 1/5 or 1/6

say.hi: Board par 5 barabar thaile hain, har ek mein 7 kele. Yahan kele nahi, thaile gino; jo thaila diya, woh 5 thailon mein se ek hai.
say.en: On the board are 5 equal bags, 7 bananas in each. Count the bags here, not the bananas; the bag given away is one of the 5 bags.

sayAlt.hi: Agar saare thaile de diye jaayein, toh ek bhi nahi bachega. Bache hue thaile neeche wale number mein likhte, toh woh 0 ho jaata, aur aisa kabhi nahi hota. Jo thaila diya, woh shuru ke 5 thailon mein se ek tha; bache 4 ginne se uska naam nahi badalta.
sayAlt.en: If every bag were given away, none would be left. If the bags left went in the bottom number, it would be 0, and that never happens. The bag given was one of the 5 bags we started with; counting the 4 left does not change its name.

simpler.hi: Ginti wahi lo jo thaila dene se pehle thi, dene ke baad wali nahi. Dene se pehle board par 5 thaile the.
simpler.en: Take the count from before the bag was given away, not after. Before it was given, the board had 5 bags.

viewCaption.hi: Paanch thaile ab ek jaal mein hain: har qatar ek thaila hai, aur har qatar mein saat kele.
viewCaption.en: The five bags are now in one grid: each row is a bag, with seven bananas in each row.

prompt.hi: 30 kele 6 thailon mein barabar bhare, aur 1 thaila kisi ko de diya. Woh thaila saare kelon ka 1/5 hai ya 1/6?
prompt.en: 30 bananas fill 6 bags equally, and 1 bag is given away. Is that bag 1/5 or 1/6 of all the bananas?

reask.hi: 30 kele ke 6 barabar thailon mein se jo 1 thaila gaya, woh saare kelon ka 1/5 hai ya 1/6?
reask.en: Of 30 bananas in 6 equal bags, is the 1 bag that went 1/5 or 1/6 of all the bananas?

viewCaption.hi: Yahan har thaila jaal ki ek qatar hai: chhe qatarein, har qatar mein paanch kele.
viewCaption.en: Here each bag is one row of the grid: six rows, five bananas in each row.

why.hi: 6 barabar thailon mein se diya hua thaila 1/6 hai; neeche wala number saare 6 thaile ginta hai, bache 5 nahi
why.en: of 6 equal bags, the bag given is 1/6; the bottom number counts all 6 bags, not the 5 left

whyShort.hi: 6 barabar thailon mein se 1 thaila, yaani 1/6
whyShort.en: 1 of 6 equal bags, so 1/6

whyAlt.hi: 5 thailon mein toh 25 kele hi aate, 30 nahi; saare 30 kele jitne thailon mein the, woh ginti neeche jaati hai
whyAlt.en: 5 bags hold only 25 bananas, not 30; the bottom takes the number of bags all 30 bananas were in

answerViewCaption.hi: Jaal ki chhe qatarein chhe thaile hain, har qatar mein 5 kele. Ek qatar di gayi, toh chhe mein se ek, 1/6.
answerViewCaption.en: The grid's six rows are the six bags, with 5 bananas in each row. One row was given away, one of six, 1/6.

simpler.hi: Kele dene se pehle board par kitne thaile the, woh gino. Jo thaila gaya, woh unmein se ek hai.
simpler.en: Count how many bags were on the board before any was given. The bag that went is one of them.

remediation.move: own board (12 toffees dealt into 3 groups of 4); the dealing test as a general method: deal all the things one at a time into 3 groups, taking turns; one group's size is 1/3; a group not that size is not 1/3; then the then-card's 21 pencils given 9, 6, 6: who has exactly 1/3 (nobody)

say.hi: Board par 12 toffee baari-baari 3 group mein daali, toh har group mein 4 aayi: 12 ka 1/3 yahi 4 hai.
say.en: On the board, 12 toffees were dealt by turns into 3 groups, and 4 landed in each: 1/3 of 12 is that 4.

sayAlt.hi: Socho, roti ke 8 barabar tukde 3 bachchon mein bate: ek ko 4, baaki do ko 2-2. 4 tukde toh roti ka aadha hain, 1/3 nahi, kyunki 4 aur 4 milkar 8 bante hain.
sayAlt.en: Picture 8 equal pieces of roti shared among 3 children: one gets 4, the other two 2 each. The 4 pieces are half the roti, not 1/3, because 4 and 4 make 8.

viewCaption.hi: Har bachche ke roti ke tukde ab ek qatar hain, teeno qatarein ek hi kinare se shuru: ek qatar chaar tukdon ki hai, aur baaki dono qatarein usse chhoti.
viewCaption.en: Each child's roti pieces are now a row, all three rows starting from the same edge: one row has four pieces, and the other two rows are shorter.

viewCaption.hi: Teen group ab ek jaal mein hain: har qatar ek group hai, aur har qatar mein chaar toffee.
viewCaption.en: The three groups are now in a grid: each row is a group, with four toffees in each row.

simpler.hi: Board par teeno group mein 4-4 toffee hain, kyunki baari-baari daali. Jis group mein utni na hon, woh 1/3 nahi.
simpler.en: On the board each of the three groups has 4 toffees, because they were dealt by turns. A group without that many is not 1/3.

prompt.hi: 21 pencil 3 doston mein bati: 9, 6 aur 6. Kiske paas theek 1/3 hai: 9 wale ke, 6 wale ke, ya kisi ke nahi?
prompt.en: 21 pencils went to 3 friends: 9, 6 and 6. Who has exactly 1/3: the one with 9, one with 6, or nobody?

viewCaption.hi: Har dost ki pencil ab ek qatar hain, teeno qatarein ek hi kinare se shuru: ek qatar mein 9, baaki do mein 6-6. Dekho, teeno qatarein kahan khatam hoti hain.
viewCaption.en: Each friend's pencils are now a row, all three rows starting from the same edge: one row has 9, the other two have 6 each. See where each of the three rows ends.

why.hi: 21 ka 1/3 tab hota jab teeno ko 7 milti; yahan kisi ke paas 7 nahi, isliye kisi ke paas 1/3 nahi
why.en: 1/3 of 21 is 7, what each gets in a fair share; nobody has 7, so nobody has 1/3

whyShort.hi: 1/3 matlab 7 pencil; kisi ke paas 7 nahi
whyShort.en: 1/3 of 21 is 7, and nobody has 7

whyAlt.hi: 9 sabse bada hai, par 1/3 ka matlab teen barabar group mein se ek; 9-9 ke teen group toh 27 pencil bana dete, par kul 21 hi hain
whyAlt.en: 9 is the biggest, but 1/3 means one of three equal groups; three groups of 9 would make 27 pencils, and there are only 21

simpler.hi: Socho, barabar baant mein har dost ko kitni milti. Phir dekho, kisi ke paas utni hai ya nahi.
simpler.en: Think how many each friend would get in a fair share. Then see whether anyone has that many.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab ek jaisi cheezon ko kabhi kam, kabhi zyada barabar tukdon mein kaatenge, aur dekhenge ki kis taraf ka tukda bada hai.
bridgeToNext.en: Next we cut things of the same size into fewer or more equal pieces, and see on which side the piece is bigger.

simpler.hi: Ab ek jaisi cheezon ke tukde aapas mein milayenge.
simpler.en: Now we compare the pieces of things of the same size.

covered.hi: Aakhir mein dekha ki ek jaisi cheez jitne zyada barabar tukdon mein kate, har tukda utna chhota hota hai.
covered.en: Last came how the more equal pieces one same-size thing is cut into, the smaller each piece is.

hook.convey: one cake (or one drawn strip) shared into 2 vs the same-size one into 4 → which single piece is bigger; more equal parts of the same whole → smaller piece

use.hi: Ek birthday cake 2 dost baant rahe hain, waisa hi doosra cake 4 dost. Pehle ek patti dekhte hain.
use.en: 2 friends are sharing a birthday cake, 4 friends an identical second cake. First let's look at a strip.

use.hi: Do ek jitni lambi patti draw karo; ek ko 2 barabar tukdon mein baanto, doosri ko 4 mein.
use.en: Draw two strips of the same length; split one into 2 equal pieces, the other into 4.

explain.convey: bar cut into 2 equal parts → one part = 1/2; shaded part reaches the middle of the bar; predict: same bar in 4 parts → is one part bigger than the half? no

viewCaption.hi: Wahi patti ab ek circle ban gayi hai: do barabar tukde, ek mein rang. Rangin tukda aur bina rang ka tukda ek jitne bade hain.
viewCaption.en: The same strip is now a circle: two equal pieces, one coloured. The coloured piece and the uncoloured one are the same size.

point.hi: Yeh patti 2 barabar tukdon mein bati hai. Rangin tukda iska aadha hai, 1/2. Dekho, rang theek beech tak jaata hai.
point.en: This strip is split into 2 equal pieces. The coloured piece is half of it, 1/2. See, the colour goes exactly to the middle.

pointAlt.hi: Is patti ko theek beech se modo, toh dono taraf bilkul barabar aati hain. Ek taraf ka tukda aadhi patti hai, 1/2, aur rangin tukda wahi hai.
pointAlt.en: Fold this strip exactly in the middle and the two sides match. One side's piece is half the strip, 1/2, and the coloured piece is that one.

prompt.hi: Socho, isi patti ko ab 4 barabar tukdon mein kaatein. Tab ek tukda is aadhe se bada hoga, aadhe ke barabar, ya aadhe se chhota?
prompt.en: Imagine this same strip now cut into 4 equal pieces. Will one piece then be bigger than this half, equal to it, or smaller than the half?

hindi.hi: Yahi patti 4 logon mein bat jaaye, toh har ek ke haath aane wala tukda rangin aadhe se bada niklega, utna hi, ya chhota?
hindi.en: If this same strip is shared among 4 people, will the piece each one gets be bigger than the coloured half, the same, or smaller?

reask.hi: Ek patti ko 4 barabar tukdon mein kaatein, toh ek tukda us patti ke aadhe se bada hoga, barabar, ya chhota?
reask.en: If a strip is cut into 4 equal pieces, will one piece be bigger than half that strip, equal to it, or smaller?

why.hi: patti 4 mein kati ho toh har tukda, 2 mein kati patti ke tukde ka aadha hota hai
why.en: cut into 4, each piece is half of a piece of the strip cut into 2

whyShort.hi: 4 mein kati patti ka tukda, 2 wale ka aadha
whyShort.en: a piece of 4 is half a piece of 2

whyAlt.hi: 4 bada number hai, par woh tukdon ki ginti hai, ek tukde ka size nahi; patti wahi hai, bas ab 4 tukdon mein bat rahi hai
whyAlt.en: 4 is a bigger number, but it counts pieces, not the size of one piece; the strip is the same, only now shared into 4 pieces

simpler.hi: Ungli se isi patti par 4 barabar tukde socho: pehla kat beech mein, phir har aadhe ke beech mein ek-ek. Ab ek tukde ko rangin aadhe se milao.
simpler.en: With your finger, picture 4 equal pieces on this strip: the first cut in the middle, then one in the middle of each half. Now compare one piece with the coloured half.

viewCaption.hi: Wahi patti ab ek circle ban gayi hai: do barabar tukde, ek mein rang.
viewCaption.en: The same strip is now a circle: two equal pieces, one coloured.

simpler.hi: Patti ke 2 barabar tukde hain, isliye neeche wala number 2. Rangin tukda inmein se akela hai, aur woh 1/2 hai, aadha.
simpler.en: The strip has 2 equal pieces, so the bottom number is 2. The coloured piece is the only one of them, and it is 1/2, a half.

explain.convey: two identical pizzas: one cut into 6 equal slices → each slice 1/6; the other only into 4 → asked which slice is bigger and what it is called

viewCaption.hi: Dono pizza ab ek jitni lambi patti ban gaye hain: pehli patti chhe barabar tukdon mein, doosri chaar mein.
viewCaption.en: Both pizzas are now strips of the same length: the first strip in six equal pieces, the second in four.

point.hi: Ab yeh do ek jaise pizza dekho. Pehla 6 barabar tukdon mein kata hai, toh uska har tukda 1/6 hai. Doosra pizza utna hi bada hai, par sirf 4 barabar tukdon mein kata.
point.en: Now look at these two identical pizzas. The first is cut into 6 equal slices, so each of its slices is 1/6. The second pizza is just as big, but cut into only 4 equal slices.

pointAlt.hi: Socho, ek pizza ke paas 6 bachche baithe hain, aur bilkul waise hi doosre pizza ke paas sirf 4. Pehle pizza par har bachche ko 1/6 milta hai, kyunki woh pizza 6 mein bata.
pointAlt.en: Picture 6 children sitting round one pizza, and only 4 round another just like it. At the first pizza each child gets 1/6, because that pizza is shared by 6.

prompt.hi: In dono pizza mein bada tukda kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: Of these two pizzas, what fraction is the bigger slice?

why.hi: 4 tukdon wale pizza ka har tukda 1/4 hai, aur woh 6 tukdon wale ke 1/6 se bada hai
why.en: each slice of the 4-slice pizza is 1/4, and that is bigger than the 1/6 slice of the 6-slice pizza

whyShort.hi: 4 wale pizza ka tukda 1/4: kam tukde, bade tukde
whyShort.en: the 4 pizza's piece is 1/4: fewer pieces, bigger pieces

whyAlt.hi: 6 bada number hai, par woh pizza ke tukdon ki ginti hai; jo pizza zyada tukdon mein kata, uska har tukda patla hota hai
whyAlt.en: 6 is the bigger number, but it counts the pizza's slices; the pizza cut into more slices has thinner slices

simpler.hi: Dono pizza ke tukde gino, phir dono ka ek-ek tukda aankh se milao.
simpler.en: Count the pieces of both pizzas, then compare one piece of each by eye.

viewCaption.hi: Dono pattiyan ek jitni lambi hain. Pehli patti ka ek tukda aur doosri patti ka ek tukda aamne-saamne dekho.
viewCaption.en: Both strips are the same length. Look at one piece of the first strip and one piece of the second strip, face to face.

simpler.hi: 1/6 ka matlab: poore pizza ke 6 barabar tukde, aur unmein se ek. Doosre pizza ki ginti alag hai, kyunki woh sirf 4 tukdon mein kata.
simpler.en: 1/6 means: the whole pizza in 6 equal slices, and one of them. The second pizza's count is different, because it is cut into only 4.

explain.convey: two strips of the same length, one cut into 2 equal pieces, one into 5; the bottom number counts the equal pieces, not their size; 5 > 2 as whole numbers does not make 1/5 bigger → asked how many 1/5 pieces fill the 1/2 piece: fewer than 2, 2, or more than 2 (two and a half); the why gives 'zyada tukde, chhota tukda'

viewCaption.hi: Wahi do pattiyan ab do ek jitne bade circle ban gayi hain: ek do barabar tukdon mein, ek paanch mein.
viewCaption.en: The same two strips are now two circles of the same size: one in two equal pieces, one in five.

point.hi: Yeh do patti ek jitni lambi hain: pehli 2 barabar tukdon mein kati, doosri 5 mein. Neeche wala number tukde ginta hai.
point.en: These two strips are the same length: the first cut into 2 equal pieces, the second into 5. The bottom number counts pieces.

pointAlt.hi: Ek bottle doodh socho, jo 2 glass mein barabar daala gaya, aur utna hi doodh 5 glass mein. Board par bhi waisa hi hai: do ek jitni patti, ek 2 barabar tukdon mein, ek 5 mein.
pointAlt.en: Think of a bottle of milk poured equally into 2 glasses, and the same amount of milk into 5 glasses. The board is like that too: two strips of the same length, one in 2 equal pieces, one in 5.

prompt.hi: Pehli patti ke 1/2 wale tukde ki jagah mein, doosri patti ke 1/5 wale kitne tukde aate hain: 2 se kam, theek 2, ya 2 se zyada?
prompt.en: In the space of the first strip's 1/2 piece, how many of the second strip's 1/5 pieces fit: fewer than 2, exactly 2, or more than 2?

reask.hi: Do ek jitni lambi patti mein, 1/2 wale ek tukde ki jagah 1/5 wale kitne tukde aate hain: 2 se kam, theek 2, ya 2 se zyada?
reask.en: In two strips of the same length, how many 1/5 pieces fit in the space of one 1/2 piece: fewer than 2, exactly 2, or more than 2?

why.hi: poori patti mein 1/5 wale 5 tukde aate hain, toh aadhi patti mein dhai; isliye 1/5 wala tukda 1/2 wale se chhota
why.en: 5 of the 1/5 pieces fill the strip, so two and a half fill half; the 1/5 piece is smaller

whyShort.hi: zyada tukde, chhota tukda: aadhi patti mein 1/5 wale dhai
whyShort.en: more pieces, smaller piece: 1/5 is smaller than 1/2

whyAlt.hi: 2 se kam kehna matlab 1/5 wala tukda bada maana, kyunki 5 bada number hai; par 5 toh patti ke tukdon ki ginti hai, tukde ka size nahi
whyAlt.en: saying fewer than 2 takes the 1/5 piece as bigger, because 5 is the bigger number; but 5 counts the strip's pieces, it is not a piece's size

simpler.hi: Pehle gino, poori doosri patti mein 1/5 wale kitne tukde hain. Phir socho, aadhi patti mein unke aadhe aayenge.
simpler.en: First count how many 1/5 pieces the whole second strip has. Then think: half the strip holds half of them.

simpler.hi: Dono chocolate ek jitni badi hain. Ek ko 3 log baantein, doosri ko 6 log; hum dono ke tukde aapas mein milayenge.
simpler.en: The two chocolates are the same size. 3 people share one, 6 share the other; we'll compare their pieces.

givens.hi: Dono chocolate ek jitni badi hain, isliye unke tukde aapas mein milaye ja sakte hain.
givens.en: The two chocolates are the same size, so their pieces can be compared.

find.hi: 3 wali chocolate ke tukdon par 6 wali chocolate ke kitne tukde aate hain
find.en: how many pieces of the 6-piece chocolate fit on pieces of the 3-piece chocolate

prompt.hi: Socho: 3 wali ke ek tukde par 6 wali ke kitne tukde aate hain?
prompt.en: Think: how many pieces of the 6 one cover one piece of the 3?

hindi.hi: Ek bada tukda 3 wali chocolate ka hai. Uski jagah bharne mein 6 wali ke chhote tukde kitne lagenge?
hindi.en: One big piece is from the 3 chocolate. How many small pieces of the 6 one will it take to fill its place?

reask.hi: Do ek jaisi chocolate mein, 3 barabar tukdon wali ke ek tukde par 6 barabar tukdon wali ke kitne tukde aate hain?
reask.en: Of two identical chocolates, how many pieces of the one in 6 equal pieces fit on one piece of the one in 3 equal pieces?

right.hi: Bilkul, 2: 3 wali ka har tukda 6 wali ke do tukde banta hai.
right.en: Exactly, 2: each piece of the 3 one makes two pieces of the 6 one.

told.hi: 6 wali ka har tukda 3 wali ke tukde ka aadha hai, isliye ek par 2.
told.en: Each piece of the 6 one is half a piece of the 3 one, so 2 fit on one.

do.hi: ek bade tukde par chhote tukde gino
do.en: Count the small pieces on one big piece

why.hi: 6 tukde 3 ke do guna hain, toh har bada tukda do mein bat jaata
why.en: 6 pieces are twice 3, so each big piece splits in two

simpler.hi: Dono chocolate ek jitni hain, toh 6 wali ke saare tukde milkar 3 wali ke saare tukdon jitne hain. Ab socho, unmein se kitne 3 wali ke ek tukde par aayenge.
simpler.en: The two chocolates are the same size, so all the 6 one's pieces together equal all the 3 one's pieces. Now think how many of them fall to one piece of the 3 one.

prompt.hi: Tumhari baari: 3 wali ke 2 tukdon par 6 wali ke kitne tukde aayenge?
prompt.en: Your turn: how many pieces of the 6 one will fit on 2 pieces of the 3 one?

reask.hi: Do ek jaisi chocolate mein, 3 barabar tukdon wali ke 2 tukdon par 6 barabar tukdon wali ke kitne tukde aayenge?
reask.en: Of two identical chocolates, how many pieces of the one in 6 equal pieces will fit on 2 pieces of the one in 3 equal pieces?

why.hi: 3 wali ke har tukde par 6 wali ke 2 tukde aate hain, toh 2 tukdon par 2 aur 2, yaani 4
why.en: 2 pieces of the 6 one fit on each piece of the 3 one, so 4 fit on 2 pieces

whyAlt.hi: 2 toh sirf ek tukde par aate hain; yahan 3 wali ke do rangin tukde hain, aur har ek par 2.
whyAlt.en: 2 is what fits on just one piece; here two pieces of the 3 one are coloured, and 2 fit on each.

simpler.hi: Board par 3 wali ke 2 rangin tukde hain. Pehle ek rangin tukde ke liye socho, phir doosre ke liye.
simpler.en: On the board are 2 coloured pieces of the 3 one. First think about one coloured piece, then about the other.

viewCaption.hi: Wahi 3 wali chocolate ab ek circle hai: teen barabar tukde, do mein rang. 6 wali chocolate board par nahi hai.
viewCaption.en: The same 3 chocolate is now a circle: three equal pieces, two coloured. The 6 chocolate is not on the board.

answerViewCaption.hi: Dono chocolate ab ek jitne bade circle hain: 3 wali ke 2 tukde rangin, aur 6 wali ke 4. Dono circle mein rang ek jitna hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The two chocolates are now circles of the same size: 2 pieces of the 3 one coloured, and 4 of the 6 one. The coloured part of both is the same size.

why.en: 2 small pieces of the 6 one fit on each big piece

viewCaption.hi: Wahi 3 wali chocolate ab ek circle hai, teen barabar tukdon mein. 6 wali chocolate board par nahi hai.
viewCaption.en: The same 3 chocolate is now a circle, in three equal pieces. The 6 chocolate is not on the board.

prompt.hi: Meena ek roti 2 barabar tukdon mein kaatti hai. Sonu waisi hi roti 9 barabar tukdon mein kaatta hai. Dono apna ek-ek tukda lete hain. Kiska tukda roti ke 1/3 se chhota hai: Meena ka, Sonu ka, ya dono ka?
prompt.en: Meena cuts a roti into 2 equal pieces. Sonu cuts the same kind of roti into 9 equal pieces. Each takes one piece. Whose piece is smaller than 1/3 of the roti: Meena's, Sonu's, or both?

did.hi: Meena aur Sonu ke tukdon ko 1/3 wale tukde se milaya
did.en: compared Meena's and Sonu's pieces with a 1/3 piece

viewCaption.hi: Meena ki roti pehli patti hai, do barabar tukdon mein; Sonu ki roti doosri patti hai, nau barabar tukdon mein. Dono pattiyan ek jitni lambi hain.
viewCaption.en: Meena's roti is the first strip, in two equal pieces; Sonu's roti is the second strip, in nine equal pieces. Both strips are the same length.

why.hi: Meena ka tukda 1/2, jo 1/3 se bada; Sonu ki roti 9 tukdon mein kati, toh uska 1/9 tukda 1/3 se chhota
why.en: Meena's piece is 1/2, bigger than 1/3; Sonu's roti is in 9 pieces, so his 1/9 is smaller than 1/3

whyShort.hi: Sonu ka tukda 1/9 hai, jo 1/3 se chhota
whyShort.en: Sonu's piece is 1/9, smaller than 1/3

whyAlt.hi: chhota number dekh kar chhota tukda mat socho; 2 tukdon mein kati roti ka har tukda poori roti ka aadha hai, bahut mota
whyAlt.en: don't take a small number to mean a small piece; a roti cut in 2 has each piece half the roti, very thick

answerViewCaption.hi: Dono pattiyan ek jitni lambi hain: Meena ka rangin tukda aadhi patti hai, aur Sonu ka rangin tukda bahut patla, 1/9. Isliye 1/3 se chhota tukda Sonu ka hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Both strips are the same length: Meena's coloured piece is half the strip, and Sonu's coloured piece is very thin, 1/9. So the piece smaller than 1/3 is Sonu's.

simpler.hi: Socho, 1/3 wala tukda banane ke liye roti kitne tukdon mein katti. Phir dekho, Meena aur Sonu ne usse kam tukde kaate ya zyada.
simpler.en: Think how many pieces a roti is cut into to make a 1/3 piece. Then see whether Meena and Sonu cut fewer pieces than that or more.

prompt.hi: Ek chocolate 8 bachchon mein barabar bati, aur utni hi badi doosri chocolate 2 bachchon mein. Farhan 8 waalon mein hai, Gita 2 waalon mein. Farhan ka tukda Gita ke tukde se zyada hai ya kam?
prompt.en: One chocolate is shared equally by 8 children, and another just as big by 2. Farhan is with the 8, Gita with the 2. Is Farhan's piece more or less than Gita's?

reask.hi: 8 mein bati chocolate ka Farhan ka tukda, 2 mein bati utni hi badi chocolate ke Gita ke tukde se zyada hai ya kam?
reask.en: Is Farhan's piece of a chocolate shared by 8 more or less than Gita's piece of one just as big shared by 2?

did.hi: 8 mein bati aur 2 mein bati chocolate ke tukde milaaye
did.en: compared pieces of chocolates shared by 8 and by 2

viewCaption.hi: Gita wali chocolate yahan ek patti hai, 2 barabar tukdon mein. Farhan wali chocolate board par nahi hai.
viewCaption.en: Gita's chocolate is a strip here, in 2 equal pieces. Farhan's chocolate is not on the board.

why.hi: Farhan ki chocolate 8 mein bati, toh uska tukda 1/8; Gita ki 2 mein, toh uska 1/2; 1/8 chhota hai
why.en: Farhan's chocolate was shared by 8, so his piece is 1/8; Gita's by 2, so hers is 1/2; 1/8 is smaller

whyShort.hi: Farhan ka tukda 1/8, Gita ka 1/2; 1/8 chhota
whyShort.en: Farhan's piece is 1/8, Gita's 1/2; 1/8 is smaller

whyAlt.hi: 8 ko Farhan ke tukde ka size maan liya; par 8 toh chocolate baantne wale bachchon ki ginti hai
whyAlt.en: 8 was taken as the size of Farhan's piece; but 8 is how many children shared the chocolate

answerViewCaption.hi: Dono chocolate ab ek jitni lambi patti hain. Gita ka rangin tukda aadhi patti hai, aur Farhan ka rangin tukda usse bahut chhota hai, isliye Farhan ka tukda kam.
answerViewCaption.en: The two chocolates are now strips of the same length. Gita's coloured piece is half the strip, and Farhan's coloured piece is much smaller, so Farhan's piece is less.

simpler.hi: Board par Gita wali chocolate 2 tukdon mein hai. Socho, wahi chocolate 8 tukdon mein kat-ti toh ek tukda kaisa dikhta, phir dono tukde milao.
simpler.en: On the board Gita's chocolate is in 2 pieces. Think how one piece would look if that same chocolate were cut into 8, then compare the two pieces.

prompt.hi: Teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: board wali 4 barabar tukdon mein kati, doosri 10 mein, teesri 7 mein. Har chocolate ka ek tukda lo, 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7, aur inhe sabse chhote se sabse bade tak lagao.
prompt.en: There are three identical chocolates: the one on the board cut into 4 equal pieces, the second into 10, the third into 7. Take one piece of each, 1/4, 1/10 and 1/7, and put them in order from smallest to biggest.

hindi.hi: Teen ek jaisi chocolate: ek ke 4 tukde, ek ke 10, ek ke 7. 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7 ko patle se mote tak kaise rakhoge?
hindi.en: Three matching chocolates: one in 4 pieces, one in 10, one in 7. How will you put 1/4, 1/10 and 1/7 from thinnest to thickest?

reask.hi: Teen ek jaisi chocolate ke 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7 tukdon ko sabse chhote se sabse bade tak kaise lagaoge?
reask.en: How do you put the 1/4, 1/10 and 1/7 pieces of three identical chocolates in order, smallest to biggest?

did.hi: teen chocolate ke tukde chhote se bade tak lagaye: 1/10, 1/7, 1/4
did.en: ordered three chocolate pieces from smallest to biggest: 1/10, 1/7, 1/4

viewCaption.hi: Board wali chocolate yahan ek patti hai, 4 barabar tukdon mein. Baaki do chocolate board par nahi hain.
viewCaption.en: The board's chocolate is a strip here, in 4 equal pieces. The other two chocolates are not on the board.

why.hi: chocolate jitne zyada tukdon mein kate, tukda utna chhota; isliye pehle 1/10, phir 1/7, phir 1/4
why.en: the more pieces a chocolate is cut into, the smaller the piece, so 1/10 first, then 1/7, then 1/4

whyShort.hi: zyada tukde, chhota tukda: 1/10, phir 1/7, phir 1/4
whyShort.en: more pieces, smaller piece: 1/10, then 1/7, then 1/4

whyAlt.hi: tumne neeche ke number chhote se bade lagaye, par sawaal tukdon ke size ka hai; socho, ek chocolate 10 dost baantein ya 4, kahan har ek ko patla tukda milega
whyAlt.en: you put the bottom numbers from small to big, but the question is about the size of the pieces; think, if 10 friends share a chocolate or 4 do, where does each get a thin piece

answerViewCaption.hi: Teeno chocolate ab ek jitni lambi patti hain, har ek ka ek tukda rangin. 10 wali ka tukda sabse patla, phir 7 wali ka, phir 4 wali ka.
answerViewCaption.en: The three chocolates are now strips of the same length, one piece of each coloured. The 10 one's piece is the thinnest, then the 7 one's, then the 4 one's.

simpler.hi: Har tukde ka neeche wala number dekho: woh batata hai chocolate kitne barabar tukdon mein kati. Phir patle tukde se mote tak lagao.
simpler.en: Look at each piece's bottom number: it tells how many equal pieces the chocolate was cut into. Then go from the thinnest piece to the thickest.

prompt.hi: Do ek jaise cake: ek ke 9 barabar tukde, ek ke 7 barabar tukde. Tumhe bada tukda chahiye, toh kis cake se loge?
prompt.en: Two identical cakes: one in 9 equal pieces, one in 7 equal pieces. You want a bigger piece: which cake do you take from?

viewCaption.hi: Dono cake ab ek jitni lambi patti hain: pehli nau barabar tukdon mein, doosri saat mein.
viewCaption.en: The two cakes are now strips of the same length: the first in nine equal pieces, the second in seven.

why.hi: 7 tukdon wala cake kam barabar tukdon mein kata, toh uska har tukda 9 wale ke tukde se bada hai
why.en: the 7-piece cake is cut into fewer equal pieces, so each of its pieces is bigger than the 9-piece cake's

whyShort.hi: kam tukde, bada tukda: 7 wale cake ka tukda bada
whyShort.en: fewer pieces, bigger piece: the 7-piece cake's is bigger

whyAlt.hi: 9 wala cake chunne mein 9 ko bade tukde ka nishaan samjha; par 9 batata hai cake 9 tukdon mein kata, toh uska har tukda patla.
whyAlt.en: choosing the 9 cake takes 9 as a sign of a big piece; but 9 tells us the cake is cut into 9 pieces, so each of its pieces is thin.

answerViewCaption.hi: Dono pattiyan ek jitni lambi hain: pehli 9 barabar tukdon mein, doosri 7 mein. 7 wali patti ka har tukda lamba hai, isliye bada tukda 7 tukdon wale cake se milta hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Both strips are the same length: the first in 9 equal pieces, the second in 7. Each piece of the 7 strip is longer, so the bigger piece comes from the cake in 7 pieces.

reask.hi: Circle ke 9 barabar tukdon mein se 4 rangin hain: yeh poore circle ka kaunsa fraction hua?

did.hi: 9 barabar tukdon wale circle ke rangin tukde fraction mein bataye

why.hi: neeche wala number circle ke saare 9 barabar tukde ginta hai, bina rang ke 5 nahi, aur upar wala rangin 4
why.en: the bottom number counts all 9 equal pieces of the circle, not the 5 uncoloured ones, and the top the 4 coloured
